requirements: R1: Fix the coverage audit report to accurately identify gaps (e.g., Moodle role sync, course-based access control, autonomous LMS fallback, 401 API failures) instead of claiming an empty gaps list.
R2: Fix the review verdict process to evaluate real code instead of approving a non-existent 'PR #0'.
R3: Enhance AuthController.fetchOidcProfile to cryptographically verify the JWT signature against the Moodle provider's public keys rather than just decoding the Base64 payload.

slices.title: Resolve Self-Falsification Audit Findings
slices.jtbd: When implementing the security and audit fixes for this epic, I want to enforce OIDC cryptographic signature verification and correct the stubbed review and coverage reports, so that the self-falsification cycle is closed with genuine implementations.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a generated coverage audit report, When it evaluates the codebase, Then it correctly identifies actual missing requirements instead of faking success.
Given a review verdict, When it is recorded, Then it evaluates real code and does not approve a non-existent PR #0.
Given an OIDC login attempt with a JWT, When AuthController.fetchOidcProfile processes it, Then it cryptographically verifies the signature against Moodle's public keys before extracting claims.
Given the self-falsification findings, When the fixes are applied, Then QA tests confirm the signature verification and audit repairs are functionally covered.
slices.tocConstraintRef: OIDC JWT signature verification and audit reporting
